director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj number line par fractions dekhenge—cricket pitch ke parts jaise. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Cricket pitch ko 1 poora distance socho; agar use 2 barabar parts mein baantein, har part kya hoga? End mein tum Golu ko sikhaogi.
Riya, 0 se 1 ko 5 equal gaps mein baantoge, har gap ek-fifth hoga. Cricket pitch ka one-fifth mark kahan aayega?
Riya, one-fifth ka pehla mark 0 ke baad hota hai; 2/5 ke liye 0 se do equal gaps count karte hain. Agla step dikhau?
Riya, question hai: 0 se 1 tak 2/5 mark karna hai. Neeche ka 5 batata hai 5 equal gaps; upar ka 2, do gaps count karwata hai.

Theek hai, Riya. Ab ek quick practice karte hain—number line par pehle total equal parts count karna, phir required parts count karna. Ghar (0) se chai ki dukaan (1) tak ki sadak 2 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Beech wale mark par kaunsa number hai?
